recommendations.statement: Assess refractive error before interpreting other visual measures.
recommendations.rationale: A refractive problem may be mistaken for VA loss and may require only corrective lenses.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — Refraction

recommendations.statement: Assess best-corrected VA monocularly where possible, using an age-appropriate method and both far and near distances.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — Visual Acuity (VA)

recommendations.statement: Attempt age-appropriate, preferably monocular VF assessment in children with a CNS neoplasm.
recommendations.context: Baseline visual assessment even when age or cooperation makes testing difficult.
recommendations.rationale: VF loss is among the visual symptoms most likely to be underreported.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — Visual Fields (VF)

recommendations.statement: Use confrontation or BEFIE testing in children < 5 years of age; use Goldmann kinetic perimetry or, preferably, automatic perimetry in older, more cooperative children.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — Visual Fields (VF)

recommendations.statement: Consider OCT when fundoscopy cannot be performed or produces inconsistent findings.
recommendations.rationale: OCT may provide a more objective assessment through RNFL thickening.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — Fundoscopic exam

recommendations.statement: Interpret OCT changes only alongside other measures of visual function.
recommendations.rationale: There is no clear consensus on how OCT changes correspond to progression or treatment response, and RNFL measurements can have artefacts.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 4. Recommended Baseline Visual Assessment -RAFFO

recommendations.statement: Continue regular ophthalmological surveillance after diagnosis and treatment, adjusting its frequency and duration to tumour location, treatment and the presence, severity and risk of visual dysfunction.
recommendations.rationale: Visual impairment may predate treatment or arise during or after it.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 5. Recommended Visual Surveillance After Treatment

recommendations.statement: Take a careful visual symptom history and perform physical, neurological and fundoscopic examinations.
recommendations.context: All children with a suspected CNS tumour.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Refer every child newly diagnosed with a CNS tumour for baseline neuro-ophthalmological evaluation.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Use a comprehensive multidisciplinary approach to diagnose and manage visual impairment.
recommendations.context: Children with newly diagnosed CNS tumour and visual signs.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Refer children with newly diagnosed CNS tumour and visual signs to a dedicated visual-impairment rehabilitation service.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Where available, consider hand-held OCT in young children and RNFL/GCL measures as VA surrogates in selected groups.
recommendations.context: The table identifies children with OPG and CP as target groups.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Do not omit or delay baseline ophthalmological assessment merely because visual symptoms are absent.
recommendations.context: All children diagnosed with a CNS tumour.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Do not discontinue ophthalmological follow-up for children treated for a CNS tumour.
recommendations.source_heading: VISUAL ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOWUP OF CHILDREN WITH A CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM NEOPLASM — 6. Must Have/Desirable/Not To Do Recommendations

recommendations.statement: Use a bio-psycho-social, interdisciplinary approach at diagnosis, during treatment and after treatment.
recommendations.context: Care of children and adolescents with CNS tumours.
